lines: Ankur Aggarwal, Promoter Selling Shareholder, sells up to 3,702,694 shares in the offer for sale, bringing money to them.
The amount is up to 3,702,694 shares offered; value unknown, as no offer price or price band is confirmed yet.
Their family link to Ankur Aggarwal KNK Family Trust gives a natural angle for a joint conversation about the family holding.
Timing, proceeds, gain and retained holding are unknown: listing date and pre-offer holding are not confirmed.
